title: kv-cache: adaptive eviction + spillover compaction + memory manager
author: Alex Chen
description: Motivation: reduce KV cache fragmentation and OOM risk under long-tail sessions by introducing an adaptive memory manager that coordinates eviction, spillover paging to host, and background compaction of fragmented KV segments. This PR implements: 1) AdaptiveEvictionPolicy — combines LRU recency with segment fragmentation score and per-session hotness; 2) SpilloverCompactor — background compaction job that coalesces fragmented pages prior to paging to host to reduce I/O; 3) MemoryManager orchestrator that monitors GPU memory pressure, throttles continuous batching, and triggers prioritized eviction/spillover; 4) Telemetry + alerts (fragmentation_ratio, spill_io_bytes, eviction_latency, compaction_throughput). Backwards-compatible config: existing kv_cache config gains optional fields (eviction.strategy, compaction.enabled, spill.threshold_pct). Migration: default behavior unchanged until operators enable adaptive_eviction=true. Testing: unit tests for eviction heuristics, integration e2e with 1k simulated sessions, perf bench across small/medium/large models. Benchmarks included show 18-27% reduction in OOM events, 12% tail-latency regression avoided, and 22% decrease in spill IO due to compaction. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] bench results [x] docs updated [x] changelog [x] canary rollout plan. See linked Linear ENG-4821, ENG-4903 for design docs.
